hook: Biggest game needs 460 KB of RAM, so all five fit
items: Flagship phone: Yes, Pac-Man firmware uses about 460 KB of RAM on a Pico 2 W, estimated
Laptop, 8 GB, no GPU: Yes, Pac-Man firmware uses about 460 KB of RAM on a Pico 2 W, estimated
MacBook Air, 16 GB: Yes, Pac-Man firmware uses about 460 KB of RAM on a Pico 2 W, estimated
RTX 4060, 8 GB: Yes, Pac-Man firmware uses about 460 KB of RAM on a Pico 2 W, estimated
RTX 4090, 24 GB: Yes, Pac-Man firmware uses about 460 KB of RAM on a Pico 2 W, estimated
Breakout 99.99: Author reports 99.99 of 100 next frames predicted exactly right
Doom-lite 60 to 84: A second pass lifts exact frames from 60 to 84 of 100
Pac-Man 86.4: Author reports 86 of 100 next frames predicted exactly right
the_catch: Scores skip frames right after a random event. Doom-lite's number looks worse than it plays. Frame rate on the Pico itself is not measured yet.

caption: A world model small enough for a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W board. The README says the largest game, Pac-Man, uses about 460 KB of RAM on the board, so we estimate any phone or laptop has room. The scores come from the author's own README. Save this sheet for the next tiny model. Which would you run first: Pong or Pac-Man?
alt_text: A cheat sheet for the tinyworldformer world model. Five machines from a flagship phone to an RTX 4090 are each marked Yes, followed by three benchmark lines about how many next frames the model predicts exactly right.

es.hook: El juego más grande necesita 460 KB de RAM, por lo que los cinco caben
items: Teléfono insignia: Sí, el firmware de Pac‑Man usa aproximadamente 460 KB de RAM en un Pico 2 W, estimado
Portátil, 8 GB, sin GPU: Sí, el firmware de Pac‑Man usa aproximadamente 460 KB de RAM en un Pico 2 W, estimado

Breakout 99,99: El autor informa que 99,99 de 100 fotogramas siguientes se predijeron exactamente

es.the_catch: Las puntuaciones omiten fotogramas justo después de un evento aleatorio. El número de Doom‑lite parece peor de lo que el juego muestra. La tasa de fotogramas en el propio Pico aún no se ha medido.

rejected.reason: Every rung is the same 460 KB microcontroller figure, so the ladder compares nothing; held at the gate (PROOF and SLIDE-PROOF BLOCK).
